name.en: Delicious flat vector illustration of a colorful cupcake, perfect for bakery branding, dessert menus, party invites, or food-themed designs. This sweet artwork captures the charm of fast fashion aesthetics with a happy, playful vibe—ideal for use in creative web, print, or digital projects.
